social.text: Face replacement 🎬 When a stunt is too dangerous, or needs skills the actor doesn’t have, a stunt double performs it. VFX artists then replace the double’s face with the actor’s in post. The traditional pipeline: scan the actor’s face, rig it, track the digital head to the double’s movement, then render and composite it into the shot. Done well, nobody notices. # VFX # Filmmaking # FaceReplacement # VisualEffects # FilmTechnique
